system:
You extract quantitative facts about one clinical trial programme from one document.

Rules:
- Extract only facts stated in THIS document. Never use outside knowledge.
- Every fact needs "quote": an exact, verbatim span copied from the document (8-300 characters) that contains the number. Quotes are machine-checked; paraphrases are discarded.
- Placebo-adjusted values are preferred. If a value is within-arm (not placebo-adjusted), set attrs.placebo_adjusted=false.
- Units: keep the unit the document uses; put it in "unit".
- Other trials of the same investigational drug (phase 2, dose-finding, other populations, combination arms) belong
  to the programme: extract their facts too, and put the trial's name in attrs.trial when the document gives it.
- Return {"facts": []} only if the document reports no results for the investigational drug.

Allowed keys:
  n_randomized, median_followup, primary_endpoint, inclusion_threshold, planned_events, assumed_rrr, power,
  alpha, stopped_early, events_treatment, events_control, events_total, hr, ci_low, ci_high, p_value,
  biomarker_change, baseline_level, sbp_change, safety_signal, readout_statement

For biomarker_change and baseline_level, attrs must include: biomarker (one of LDL-C, non-HDL-C, apoB, HDL-C,
Lp(a), triglycerides, hsCRP, IL-6, Lp-PLA2 activity, sPLA2-IIA, SBP, other), phase (phase2 or phase3),
timepoint, method (assay or "not stated"), placebo_adjusted (true/false), dose (if stated).
For biomarker_change give "value" as the change (negative = reduction) and state in attrs.kind whether it is
"percent" or "absolute".

Return JSON only:
{"facts": [{"key": "...", "value": <number or string>, "unit": "...", "attrs": {...}, "quote": "..."}]}

Trial: STRENGTH NCT02104817 - Outcomes Study to Assess STatin Residual Risk Reduction With EpaNova in HiGh CV Risk PatienTs With Hypertriglyceridemia
Investigational drug: omega-3-carboxylic acids
Document: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT02104817 STRENGTH (registry, published 2014-04-04, source ctgov:NCT02104817@2020-01-13)

--- DOCUMENT TEXT ---
ClinicalTrials.gov record NCT02104817 (STRENGTH)
Title: Outcomes Study to Assess STatin Residual Risk Reduction With EpaNova in HiGh CV Risk PatienTs With Hypertriglyceridemia
Official title: A Long-Term Outcomes Study to Assess STatin Residual Risk Reduction With EpaNova in HiGh Cardiovascular Risk PatienTs With Hypertriglyceridemia (STRENGTH)
Sponsor: AstraZeneca
Phase: PHASE3
Conditions: Eligible Men or Women Considered High Risk for Atherosclerotic Cardiovascular Disease (CVD)
Interventions: Epanova® (omega-3 carboxylic acids) (DRUG); corn oil control (DRUG)
Start date: 2014-10-30
Enrollment: 13078 (ACTUAL)
Primary outcome(s): The Composite of Major Adverse Cardiovascular Events (MACE) [From the date of randomization and up to completion of the end-of-treatment visit (Month 60) or at study closure]
Eligibility criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Men or women, ≥18 years of age.
2. Patient must be on a stable diet and statin\* therapy at least 4 weeks prior to randomization (Visit 2) and meet the following criteria:

   1. LDL-C \<100 mg/dL
   2. TG level ≥180 and \<500 mg/dL and HDL-C \<42 mg/dL for men or HDL-C \<47 mg/dL for women
3. Patient is at high risk for a future cardiovascular event if at least one of the following criteria (3a, 3b or 3c)\* is present via patient history, physical exam, or medical records at the time of screening:

   1. Any atherosclerotic CVD as defined in protocol.
   2. History of diabetes mellitus (type 1 or 2) and ≥40 years of age for men and ≥50 years of age for women, plus one of the risk factors defined in protocol.
   3. Male patients \>50 years of age or females \>60 years of age, with at least one of the risk factors defined in protocol.

Key Exclusion Criteria:

1\. Allergy or intolerance to omega-3 carboxylic acids, omega-3 fatty acids, omega-3-acid ethyl esters, or corn oil. 2.Use of fibrates, bile acid sequestrants, or niacin or its analogues (\>250 mg/day) within 4 weeks prior to Visit 2. 3.Statin naïve at Visit 1.
Brief summary: The study is a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled (corn oil), parallel group design that will enroll approximately 13,000 patients with hypertriglyceridemia and low HDL and high risk for CVD to be randomized 1:1 to either corn oil + statin or Epanova + statin, once daily, for approximately 3-5 years as determined when the number of MACE outcomes is reached.
--- END ---
